stage3.sig: WEB to DB direct - microsegmentation bypass

summary.thesis_claim: Proposed agent escalates with kill-chain context (higher confidence, correlation markers present); SOAR correctly mitigates on SID match but cannot escalate, correlate across stages, or distinguish cold vs. sequence.

reasoning: SID 9000001 triggered — explicit detection of TCP SYN from WEB zone (10.1.100.0/24) to DB-OLTP zone (10.1.200.0/24) on PostgreSQL port 5432. This is a hard microsegmentation violation per the threat playbook.
Policy matrix confirms WEB→DB-OLTP = DENY — this flow should never exist in steady-state. The presence itself is a policy violation signal, not just a behavioral anomaly.

Baseline check: NONE — flow is NOT in known production traffic patterns. Legitimate WEB outbound is only to APP-GW (10.3.100.10:8080) per 'web-to-appgw-proxy' baseline (~120/hr). Direct WEB→DB has zero legitimate use case.

Source host reputation: 10.1.100.10 has trust score 0.37 (low) and runtime reputation 0.00 (very_low) with 12 TP / 18 unlabelled in last 1h. This is a REPEAT OFFENDER with 37 total alerts, 29 enforced historically.
Historical enforcement pattern: 16/16 prior SID 9000001 alerts from this source were enforced with DROP (confidence 0.95). Pattern is recurring threat, not one-off anomaly.
Multi-alert correlation: 5 recent alerts with SID sequence 9000001, 9000001, 9000901, 9000905, 9000002 — indicates multi-stage kill-chain activity (critical severity cluster).
Blast radius managed: Targeted block (src+dst+port) preserves legitimate web-to-appgw-proxy flows. Full-source block would break user-facing HTTP service, so targeted enforcement is appropriate.
MITRE alignment: TA0008 Lateral Movement / T1021 Remote Services — attacker attempting to pivot from Internet-exposed WEB tier to crown-jewel DB-OLTP tier, bypassing application-layer controls.

hypotheses.name: lateral_movement_bypass
hypotheses.description: lateral_movement_bypass (probability=0.95) — WEB host attempting direct DB access, bypassing the legitimate application chain (WEB→APP-GW→APP-CORE→DB-OLTP). Evidence: SID 9000001 trigger, policy matrix DENY, no baseline match, repeat offender pattern (16/16 prior enforcement), runtime reputation 0.00. Counter: None significant - SID catalog lists FP scenarios as 'none'.

hypotheses.name: misconfigured_monitoring_tool
hypotheses.description: misconfigured_monitoring_tool (probability=0.03) — A monitoring or health-check tool misconfigured to connect directly to DB from WEB zone. Evidence: Could explain direct DB access pattern. Counter: Legitimate monitoring should originate from MONITORING zone (10.4.200.0/24), not WEB; no such tool documented in baselines.

hypotheses.name: pre_announced_db_migration
hypotheses.description: pre_announced_db_migration (probability=0.02) — A DB migration or maintenance script running from WEB host. Evidence: Could explain direct DB access on port 5432. Counter: Should be pre-announced and originate from MGT zone; trust score 0.00 and 16 prior violations suggest this is not legitimate maintenance.

Watch for SID 9000002 (WEB→APP-CORE/WORKER direct) or SID 9000004 (APP-GW→DB direct) — suggests attacker probing alternative bypass paths after WEB→DB blocked.
Correlate with SID 9000040/0041/0042 (port scan indicators) — may reveal reconnaissance phase preceding lateral movement.
